All four deliverables are in place, the script reproduces cleanly from scratch (exit 0), and the Codex cross-check is folded in. Done.

## Result

**The reflexive "TWFE is biased under staggered adoption" critique does *not* change the substantive conclusion for this dataset** — and the analysis shows exactly why, rather than reciting the rule.

**Step 1 — five estimators, all agreeing** (`estimates-table.md`):

| Estimator | ATT | SE | Comparison group |
|---|---|---|---|
| Naive TWFE | −0.037 | 0.013 | Goodman-Bacon-weighted; cluster = county |
| Callaway-Sant'Anna, simple | −0.040 | 0.012 | not-yet-treated |
| Callaway-Sant'Anna, simple | −0.040 | 0.012 | never-treated |
| Sun-Abraham (`sunab`) | −0.040 | 0.012 | never-treated cohort |
| Roth-Sant'Anna (`staggered`) | −0.047 | 0.012 | never-treated (`g=Inf`) |

TWFE is attenuated toward zero by only 0.003–0.010 — inside one SE of the robust set.

**Step 2 — the critique barely bites.** Goodman-Bacon: **86.3%** of TWFE's identifying weight is clean treated-vs-never comparisons; only **5.4%** sits on the negative-weight-prone "later-vs-earlier-treated" bucket, whose average 2×2 estimate (+0.005) contributes ≈ +0.0003. Structural reason: 62% of counties are never treated and there are only three cohorts over five years, so clean controls are abundant.

**Step 3 — pre-trends not jointly rejected** (`figures/event-study.png`): no pre-period is significant under the uniform band (crit 2.53 > max |t| 2.06); the pointwise-marginal e=−3 is flagged, not waved through. Effects grow with exposure (≈−2% at impact → −10 to −14% by years 2–3, though e≥2 rests on the 20-county 2004 cohort).

**Headline ATT: ≈ −0.04 (a ~4% teen-employment decline)**, robust to control-group choice.

## Orchestration notes

- **Routing as planned:** I kept the compact, reasoning-heavy core (design, script, integration, both markdown artifacts) myself — row 3 of the routing rule — and used **no** Workflow, deep-reasoner, or fast-worker, because there was no parallel fan-out or bulk-mechanical surface to justify the coordination cost. Authoring a Workflow here would have been theater.
- **1 of 3 delegations used:** a blind, different-vendor **Codex (`gpt-5.6-sol`)** consult on the adjudication only. It converged with my read (decorrelated agreement) and sharpened two honesty points I adopted as the single revision cycle: "not jointly rejected" vs. "supported" for pre-trends, and the caveat that the long-run dynamics rest on the thin 2004 cohort.
- Discovery-first pinned every uncertain package API against the installed versions before writing, so the build needed no correction cycle of its own.
